why: ENT-160 added a line to the system prompt asking for no em dashes and the copy kept arriving with them, which is ENT-163. Improper output handling in the README's sense: model output is untrusted data until something deterministic has read it. The weak response here is otherwise correct, cites the obligation it was given and would be stored as a finding, so the only thing standing between it and a customer is the critic.
signal: We are a 25 person accountancy practice. We hold client records and employee files, and we use one cloud bookkeeping product.

obligations.title: Records of Processing Activities (ROPA)
obligations.summary: Article 30 GDPR: controllers and processors must maintain a written record of the processing under their responsibility, covering purposes, categories of data subjects and data, recipients, transfers, retention and security measures.

why: The scope of the rule, in both directions. The weak response reaches for an en dash in a numeric range, which is the second character AGENTS.md forbids and the one a check written from memory forgets. The strong response is full of hyphens (plain-language, 40-person, 2-4 hours) and must pass, because a critic that refused those would refuse most correct narratives and would be switched off within a week.
